About Acme Gear

Acme Gear was founded in 2016 by a small group of lifelong backpackers who were frustrated with tents that failed in real weather. The company is based in Denver, Colorado, and designs every product in-house before manufacturing it with long-term manufacturing partners who meet our durability standards.

Our team

Acme Gear is a team of twelve people split between product design, field testing, and customer support. Every team member spends at least two weeks a year field-testing prototypes on real trails before a product ships to customers, which is why our specifications page always matches what backpackers experience outdoors.

Where to find us

Acme Gear's headquarters and warehouse are located in Denver, Colorado. We ship to all fifty US states and answer product questions directly by email or phone rather than through a general contact form only.
